SELECT * FROM tb_assessment_time t WHERE ( (
(t.direction = #{direction} AND (t.grade = #{enrollmentYear} OR t.grade IS NULL)) OR (t.direction IS NULL AND (t.grade = #{enrollmentYear} OR t.grade IS NULL))
t.direction = #{direction} OR (t.direction IS NULL AND t.grade IS NULL)
t.grade = #{enrollmentYear} OR t.grade IS NULL
1 = 0
) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_assessment_question q JOIN tb_assessment_answer a ON a.question_id = q.id WHERE q.assessment_time_id = t.id AND a.user_id = #{userId} ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_assessment_decision d JOIN tb_assessment_time t2 ON t2.id = d.assessment_time_id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.passed = false AND t2.direction IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.direction AND t2.grade IS NOT DISTINCT FROM t.grade AND t2.epoch > 0 AND (t.epoch = 0 OR t2.epoch < t.epoch) ) ORDER BY t.id DESC
